text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe injures herself towards the end of training, so I bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. This is all my fault… I was being careless…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Wait… Why are…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's just… The infirmary has a lot of visitors today…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says that, but it looks completely empty to me…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um, I'll be fine… Let's get back to training…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Besides, my injury's nothing serious…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I… appreciate you looking out for me, but…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It looks like the beds are all taken by the other patients…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The beds look empty to me, so the patients must be invisible to everyone but her…
choice_data_list: Let's sit and wait until a bed's free.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Okay… That should be all right…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right. I brought some coffee to drink after training…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll go get it…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Okay, thank you… I'm sorry for the trouble…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After drinking some coffee together, I have her rest in an available bed.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Thank you for understanding. Well then…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, a gust of cold air rushes past.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait… They're still… Stop!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Sorry about that. My injury hurts, so I think I'll just rest…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind… could you bring me something to drink?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: In the meantime, I'll… try to take care of things here.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll be fine… Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She practically forces me out of the room. By the time I return with a drink, she looks completely exhausted…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hehe… They turned the lights off…
choice_data_list: Is this their way of telling us to go train?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Yes. And they're cheering us on while they're at it…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, everyone's decided to come along…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It seems like they're curious about our training…
choice_data_list: We'd better show them what we can do.
We'd better show them what we can do.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Yes. Let's put in double the effort.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After our training session, I realize that I don't see any traces of her injury. It's as if it mysteriously disappeared.
